030package dev.visdb.seesaw.decorators;
031
032import dev.visdb.seesaw.utils.SsComponent.ValidationResult;
033
034/**
035 * Some handling for the TextDecorator; {@link #handleTextDecorator(ValidationResult)}
036 * should be called at the end of subclass' decorate().
037 */
038public abstract class BaseDecorator extends BaseAnyDecorator implements Decorator {
039  private boolean decorateTextEnabled = true;
040
041  /**
042   * Focus decorators typically decorate text as well;
043   * this can be used to control that behavior.
044   * @param flag
045   */
046  @Override
047  public void setDecorateTextEnabled(boolean flag) {
048    decorateTextEnabled = flag;
049  }
050
051  /**
052   * Deal with a TextDecorator for this component.
053   * @param valid
054   */
055  protected void handleTextDecorator(ValidationResult valid) {
056    if (!decorateTextEnabled)
057      return;
058    TextDecorator td = getSsComponent().getTextDecorator();
059    assert td != null;
060    if (td instanceof ComponentStateTextDecorator std)
061      std.decorateText(valid);
062    else
063      td.decorateText();
064  }
065}
